title: Sheinbaum: Official Documents Show the Interventionist Character of U.S. Agencies
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Alma E.
Muñoz](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz)
originally appeared in the [October 7, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/07/politica/sheinbaum-
reconoce-el-caracter-injerencista-de-agencias-de-estados-unidos), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Although she previously said she should be very careful in
her positions regarding the United States, President Claudia Sheinbaum
maintained that there are many books, publications and even official documents
that attest to the interventionist character of U.S. agencies. Moreover, she
stressed, **there are documents from these same agencies that prove
interventionist actions** , as occurred recently in events related to the
Tlatelolco massacre.

Asked directly about the harsh terms in which former President Andrés Manuel
López Obrador refers to the U.S. ambassador to Mexico, Ronald Johnson, for
interventionist actions, Sheinbaum said that the position López Obrador set
out in his book _Pueblo_ on episodes such as the arrest of Ismael _El Mayo_
Zambada was very interesting but, she noted, she must take care of her
relationship with the United States and with the whole world.

> When I know there is interference I say so without a problem, but I also
> have to seek to maintain a diplomatic relationship, and when we don't agree
> we say so, and there is a basic principle, respect for our sovereignty.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

Elaborating on López Obrador's statements on the Sinaloa case, the President
said that, regarding the accusations the United States has made about that
state, **her government has always required evidence**. She said that, in
contrast, for the Mexican government there are clear elements in the Sinaloa
case, since it is a fact that **U.S. authorities received several relatives of
Joaquín Guzmán Loera,_El Chapo_**.

On another matter, she declined to comment on the anniversary of Morena,
although she expressed pride in belonging to that movement.
